tagline.en: Daily-pay eSIMs across 160+ destinations with carrier-grade plans
tagline.zh: 160+目的地按日计费eSIM，运营商级套餐

description.en: BCeSIM is the travel eSIM service of Billion Connect, offering plans for 160+ destinations from its official storefront. Most packages are daily plans billed per day — such as 1 GB/day or 10 Mbps/day unlimited — alongside fixed data bundles and true unlimited day passes on selected routes like Japan KDDI 4-day and South Korea SKT.
description.zh: BCeSIM 是亿点全球（Billion Connect）旗下的旅行eSIM服务，官方商店覆盖160+目的地。多数套餐为按日计费的日付方案——如1 GB/日或10 Mbps/日不限量——同时提供固定流量包，以及日本KDDI 4天、韩国SKT等线路的真不限量日包。

details.en:
BCeSIM's catalogue is built around per-day pricing, which makes it easy to price out a trip precisely. On the Japan route, the IIJ-backed fixed bundles give you a full day of data at 256 kbps after the high-speed slice — 3 GB at US$3.20, 5 GB at US$4.10, 10 GB at US$8.90, 20 GB at US$13.10 and 30 GB at US$18.50 — while the KDDI 5G line is genuinely unlimited at full speed: US$10.70 for 4 days, US$17.60 for 7 days, US$33.80 for 15 days and US$71.20 for 31 days.

South Korea runs on SKT with true unlimited data (US$23.58 / 7 days, US$48.40 / 30 days).

In the USA, day plans start at US$1.07 for 1 GB/day, fixed bundles run 5 GB / US$3.90 to 50 GB / US$29.60, and an unlimited 10 Mbps tier costs US$2.31/day.

Regional products such as USA+Canada, HK+Macau and multi-country Asia packs round out the catalogue.

Most plans list hotspot support explicitly, and eSIM carrier validity is generous (60–180 days from installation before activation).
details.zh:
BCeSIM 的价目以按日计费为骨架，行程成本可以算得很精确。日本线方面，IIJ 线路的固定包在高速流量用尽后以 256 kbps 降速续用——3 GB 3.20 美元、5 GB 4.10 美元、10 GB 8.90 美元、20 GB 13.10 美元、30 GB 18.50 美元；KDDI 5G 线路则是全程真不限量：4 天 10.70 美元、7 天 17.60 美元、15 天 33.80 美元、31 天 71.20 美元。韩国线走 SKT 真不限量（7 天 23.58 美元、30 天 48.40 美元）。美国方向 1 GB/日 1.07 美元起，固定包 5 GB 3.90 美元至 50 GB 29.60 美元，另有 10 Mbps 不限量 2.31 美元/日的档位。区域产品覆盖美加、港澳及多国亚洲包。

多数套餐明确标注支持热点，且 eSIM 载体有效期宽松（安装后 60–180 天内激活均可）。

bestFor.en: Travellers who want carrier-grade unlimited routes (Japan KDDI, Korea SKT) at transparent per-day prices, and long validity windows between buying and flying.
bestFor.zh: 想要运营商级真不限量线路（日本 KDDI、韩国 SKT）且按日透明计价的旅行者，以及买了先囤着、激活窗口长的用户。
